import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Set style
sns.set_style("whitegrid")
plt.rcParams['figure.figsize'] = [14, 10]
plt.rcParams['font.size'] = 12

# Load data
df = pd.read_csv('data/titanic.csv')

# Create figure with subplots
fig = plt.figure(constrained_layout=True, figsize=(16, 12))
gs = fig.add_gridspec(3, 3)

# Subplot 1: Survival by class and gender (heatmap style)
ax1 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, :2])
survival_pivot = df.pivot_table(
    values='survived', 
    index='class', 
    columns='sex', 
    aggfunc='mean'
)
sns.heatmap(
    survival_pivot, 
    annot=True, 
    fmt='.2%', 
    cmap='RdYlGn', 
    cbar_kws={'label': 'Survival Rate'},
    ax=ax1
)
ax1.set_title('Survival Rate by Passenger Class and Gender', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_xlabel('Gender')
ax1.set_ylabel('Passenger Class')

# Subplot 2: Age distribution by survival
ax2 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 2])
survived_age = df[df['survived'] == 1]['age'].dropna()
not_survived_age = df[df['survived'] == 0]['age'].dropna()

bins = np.arange(0, 85, 5)
ax2.hist([survived_age, not_survived_age], bins=bins, 
         label=['Survived', 'Did not survive'], 
         color=['#2ecc71', '#e74c3c'], alpha=0.7, stacked=True)
ax2.set_xlabel('Age')
ax2.set_ylabel('Count')
ax2.set_title('Age Distribution by Survival Status', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax2.legend()
ax2.set_xlim(0, 80)

# Subplot 3: Fare distribution by class and survival
ax3 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 0])
sns.boxplot(data=df, x='class', y='fare', hue='survived', 
            palette={0: '#e74c3c', 1: '#2ecc71'}, ax=ax3)
ax3.set_yscale('log')
ax3.set_title('Fare Distribution by Class and Survival', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_xlabel('Passenger Class')
ax3.set_ylabel('Fare (log scale)')
ax3.legend(title='Survived', labels=['No', 'Yes'])

# Subplot 4: Survival by embarkation port
ax4 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 1])
embark_survival = df.groupby('embark_town')['survived'].agg(['mean', 'count']).reset_index()
bars = ax4.bar(embark_survival['embark_town'], embark_survival['mean'], 
               color=['#3498db', '#e74c3c', '#2ecc71'])
ax4.set_title('Survival Rate by Embarkation Port', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_xlabel('Embarkation Port')
ax4.set_ylabel('Survival Rate')
ax4.set_ylim(0, 1)

# Add count labels on bars
for i, (bar, count) in enumerate(zip(bars, embark_survival['count'])):
    height = bar.get_height()
    ax4.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2., height + 0.02,
             f'n={count}', ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=10)

# Subplot 5: Family size vs survival
ax5 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 2])
df['family_size'] = df['sibsp'] + df['parch'] + 1
family_survival = df.groupby('family_size')['survived'].agg(['mean', 'count']).reset_index()
family_survival = family_survival[family_survival['count'] >= 10]  # Filter for meaningful groups

scatter = ax5.scatter(family_survival['family_size'], family_survival['mean'], 
                      s=family_survival['count']*2, alpha=0.6, 
                      c=family_survival['mean'], cmap='RdYlGn')
ax5.set_xlabel('Family Size')
ax5.set_ylabel('Survival Rate')
ax5.set_title('Survival Rate by Family Size', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax5.set_xticks(range(1, 12))
ax5.set_xlim(0.5, 11.5)
ax5.set_ylim(0, 1)

# Add colorbar for survival rate
cbar = plt.colorbar(scatter, ax=ax5)
cbar.set_label('Survival Rate')

# Subplot 6: Survival by age groups and class
ax6 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, :])
df['age_group'] = pd.cut(df['age'], bins=[0, 12, 18, 30, 50, 80], 
                         labels=['Child', 'Teen', 'Young Adult', 'Adult', 'Senior'])
age_class_survival = df.groupby(['age_group', 'class'])['survived'].mean().unstack()

age_class_survival.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax6, color=['#e74c3c', '#3498db', '#2ecc71'])
ax6.set_title('Survival Rate by Age Group and Passenger Class', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax6.set_xlabel('Age Group')
ax6.set_ylabel('Survival Rate')
ax6.legend(title='Passenger Class')
ax6.set_ylim(0, 1)

# Add overall title
fig.suptitle('Titanic Passenger Survival Analysis', fontsize=18, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)

# Save figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150, facecolor='white')
plt.close()
